$comment: Stories with THREE amounts to add (Year pages R, 2026-11-14; 1.OA.A.2 'word problems that call for addition of three whole numbers whose sum is less than or equal to 20'). All three amounts are told ({n1} {n2} {n3}, each 2 to 9), the total is asked. Slots as in word-problems-levelset.json: {noun} {name}, {Q} = how many, agreeing (es, pt, it), {il} = il / elle of the name (fr). The thing is named after the first amount only, so no frame needs a second form of the noun. Read by a native reader (2026-11-14). The frame with a table, a box and a basket says "there are" in de, nl, sv, da and no (no "lie": a toy car stands), so it suits every thing. Only the three-number story page reads this file.
